rule.benchmark: the Sky savings rate read from sUSDS.ssr() at each snapshot, applied to the days up to the next one; check: the study's constant 3.80%
rule.capital: cash10: K = 1 + 10% buffer + maintenance margin (xyz 2% -> 1.12; Hyperliquid PAXG 5% -> 1.15); the short's margin is 12% / 15% of notional (leverage 8.3x / 6.7x)
rule.costs: one side of both legs (taker fee + measured half-spread) at entry and on the last scored day (the study closes at the end of its sample); rebalancing after a 5% perp move (half the buffer) costs the move times both legs' one-side cost
rule.daily_return: funding the short received in (d 00:00, d+1 00:00] UTC + the change of the token-minus-perp basis b = T/F - 1: r = (F/F_prev) b - b_prev + f (day_return), marks = the close of the hourly bar ending at 00:00 UTC (Hyperliquid trade bars, Binance spot klines)
kill: trailing 30-day venue funding below 5.8% a year
PAXG's premium to spot below -50bp (daily median of open hours, PAXG@binance over the Binance XAU index: the study's primary path)
xyz changes its oracle method or delists GOLD (delisting automatic; oracle drift flagged for review)
Hyperliquid halts or auto-deleverages positions (missing funding hours flagged; ADL is not visible in the public API)
rule.position: long 1 PAXG (Binance spot PAXGUSDT) per ounce short on the perp, from 00:00 UTC of the first day after registration, always on (the rule the study chose for both lines)
rule.promote: the findings' rule: forward excess above 2% a year with NW t > 2 through 2026-12, surviving Benjamini-Hochberg at q = 0.10 (forward family: the two lines); no verdict before 90 days
rule.statistics: annualised mean daily excess x 365; Newey-West t with 30 lags (as the study)
rule.study: research/2026-10-10/gold_carry (findings.md: the two watch lines; analysis.json carry blocks)

summary.verdict: hl:PAXG x PAXG@bn: accumulating (0 of 90 days); hl:xyz:GOLD x PAXG@bn: accumulating (0 of 90 days)
